verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature docs describe progress reporting: burn-down charts and cycle-time measurement [jira-docs-9], visibility into company progress toward priorities [jira-docs-14], and progress views such as boards, lists, timeline and calendars [jira-docs-11]. Nothing in the pack mentions building customizable dashboards or configuring widgets, so the core 'build dashboards' element is unevidenced. missing for 10: explicit documentation of dashboard creation, configurable widgets/gadgets, sharing dashboards with stakeholders, and independent or hands-on corroboration of dashboard reporting.
